written_before: the test split was read: no test-split result exists when this rule is merged on main (the kit's dry run used validation rows in place of test rows and never opened the test split)
run_by: Jayakrishna, once, with scripts/final_test.py, after release 1.0.0 is merged on main and tagged v1.0.0

model.cut_offs: the shipped per-category cut-offs in artifacts/selected.json; nothing is tuned on the test split

measure: macro-F1 over the 8 categories on the UNFAIR-ToS test split (1,607 sentences)

rule.difference: test macro-F1 minus honest validation macro-F1
rule.if_within: CONSISTENT with the honest validation estimate
rule.if_below: LOWER than the honest validation estimate
rule.if_above: HIGHER than the honest validation estimate

reported_only: micro-F1, flags per 100 sentences, correct tags, wrong tags and missed labels on the test split
precision, recall and F1 for each category, next to the honest validation F1 of that category
after_the_result: The test split is read once and never again. Nothing in the product changes because of the test result before the final submission; the result is reported whatever it shows, next to the validation numbers.
